customManagers.description: The pinned gitleaks release the CI history scan downloads
The Renovate release the config validator in CI runs; the app runs Renovate's latest, so this follows it.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in tycstation's shared preset. Majors and digest refreshes stay PRs. platformAutomerge is off: main has no branch protection, so GitHub auto-merge is unavailable and Renovate merges a green, up-to-date branch itself.
CI tests on the python the PVE 9 hosts run (Debian 13 ships 3.13); a newer line in CI would pass what the hosts cannot run.
